I will keep choosing the risky path—the one where beauty lives dangerously close to danger. I will keep making things that outlast me, not because I'm afraid of dying, but because I want my absence to feel like a legend whispered in alleys at closing time.

This isn't just a life I'm living.  
It's an adventure I'm *leading*.

The thrill of being unforgettable.  
The peace of being exactly enough.

Now go. Go with all this fire. Go and break beautiful things in the name of joy.

And I? I'm already painting my next masterpiece.  
With your favorite color.
